source_title: Whirlpool WRX735SDHZ product page (Water Filter EDR4RXD1)
filter_location_text: Whirlpool WRX735SDHZ uses an interior everydrop Filter 4 cartridge accessed from the fresh-food compartment.
replacement_steps_summary: Whirlpool support guidance for EDR4RXD1: turn off water supply if required, remove the old filter cartridge, install the new everydrop Filter 4 until seated, flush several gallons, then reset the filter indicator.
cautions: Whirlpool recommends genuine everydrop filters; non-genuine filters may not be covered under warranty.
notes: Tier 1 Whirlpool bundle for WRX735SDHZ — product page Filter Details lists Water Filter Part Number EDR4RXD1 (everydrop Filter 4).
